about_the_game:
GRAB YOUR GEAR. BRING YOUR FRIENDS. REALITY IS COLLAPSING.

Paraxima is an online co-op (up to 3 players) horror game where you and your team of operatives are all that stands between reality and its total collapse, the Terminus.

Enter unstable Breach zones—once-normal places now being torn apart by mysterious paranormal Entities. Your mission is not to stop what's coming, but to slow the inevitable.

TEAMWORK IS NON-NEGOTIABLE

You are not superheroes; just operatives with The Organization's supply of specialized equipment that allows for dynamic team roles.

  • Track Echoes with your Bracer.

  • Scan for data with advanced equipment and sensors.

  • Monitor your team's vitals and GTL feedback from the Safe Room.

  • Tune your containment device and carry out the protocol.

Adapt your strategy on the fly: swap equipment with teammates, or have a low-sanity operative retreat to the operations Safe Room to take over monitoring duties. Constant communication and dynamic role-switching are vital. In Paraxima, you adapt together or die alone.

THE MISSION: CLASSIFY & CONTAIN

Success demands cooperation, observation, and nerves of steel.

  • INVESTIGATE harrowing, everyday locations to find rifts in reality.

  • GATHER DATA using specialized tools and sensors to measure Echoes.

  • CLASSIFY the hostile Entity by observing how it affects the world... and your teammates.

  • TUNE your containment device to the specific threat.

  • ESCAPE with your life. Failure means another piece of your world is lost forever.

YOUR ACTIONS HAVE CONSEQUENCES

Be careful. The Entity is observing. Every action you and your team take—every door you open, every word you speak, every tool you use—might be an Infringement.

These Infringements directly influence the Global Threat Level (GTL), your critical interface for monitoring the Breach's instability. As the GTL rises, the Entity's manifestations escalate from subtle whispers to intense, sanity-draining events. Learn the Entity's patterns, manage your Infringements, and don't let the terror overwhelm you.

SLOW THE INEVITABLE

Successful containment missions provide you with valuable experience and classified data. Fuel your Progression to unlock new, certified equipment and Customization options to personalize your gear.

Face down different Breach zones, master rotating Challenges, and adapt to new Entity Events in regular content updates. With The Organization’s means at your disposal, your long-term service is all that's buying humanity a little more time.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i7 4770 or AMD equivalent (AMD FX 9500+ Series)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DX11 compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD Required / Not compatible with Mac products
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 9600 or AMD equivalent (AMD Ryzen 3600+ Series)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 or RX 5700-XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DX11 compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD Required / Not compatible with Mac products

short_description: An online co-op horror (up to 3 players) where you investigate Breaches as reality collapses. Every action is an Infringement that raises the danger, angering the Entity. Use dynamic tool-based roles to classify, contain, and escape before your sanity breaks. Adapt together or die alone.
